data.one_liner: Mocks for Firebase Auth to enable unit testing of authentication flows.
data.what_it_does: Provides a MockFirebaseAuth that mimics Firebase Auth behavior, including sign‑in, sign‑out, user management and event streams. It also allows throwing custom exceptions for testing error handling.
use_when: Writing unit tests for Firebase Auth flows
Mocking Firebase Auth in CI environments
avoid_when: Replacing real Firebase Auth in production code
strengths: Compatible with google_sign_in_mocks for Google sign‑in tests
weaknesses: Only works with Flutter (no pure Dart support)
Requires firebase_auth dependency, adding weight to the project
No support for all firebase_auth methods (e.g., fetchSignInMethodsForEmail removed)
Documentation focuses on usage, not advanced configuration
data.setup_notes: Add to dev_dependencies, import package, no special permissions or build_runner needed
